label: activeToolOnly: a brush key steps the Brush's settings whatever tool is active, so the eraser takes the brush's size
oneStepForAll: a digit with the Move tool sets each selected layer as its own undo step
replace: for other in selectedLayerIDs { endAdjust(); layerSelection.replace([other]); setOpacity(other, percent: percent) }; _ = id

label: coalesced: two digits in a row merge into one undo step
